The dataset **"subset_white_final_GE_dic_trans.Rdata"** contains all processed variables needed for GE mediations (**AFTER** gene transformations, and selection of genes associated with at least 1 stress categories).


```{r}
load("../data/subset_white_final_GE_dic_trans.Rdata")
library(dplyr)
```


## 1) Mediations with CF-Linear:


```{r}
# New gene variables: 
score_vars = c( "proinflam", "antiviral", "ctra", "ALLcluster1mean", "ALLcluster2mean", "ALLcluster3mean", "ALLcluster4mean", "ALLcluster5mean", "ALLcluster6mean", "ALLcluster8mean", "ALLcluster9mean", "ALLcluster10mean", "ALLcluster1eig", "ALLcluster2eig", "ALLcluster3eig", "ALLcluster4eig", "ALLcluster5eig", "ALLcluster6eig", "ALLcluster8eig", "ALLcluster9eig" )

# List of GENES:
index_f=which(names(subset_white_final_GE_dic_trans) == "RA6RFOS") # Column number of the first gene
index_l=which(names(subset_white_final_GE_dic_trans) == "RA6ROASL") # last gene --> Remaining genes are covariates
# Get the gene names (42 genes):
  # Extract the names of the columns:
all_genes = colnames(subset_white_final_GE_dic_trans)[index_f:index_l]
all_genes

# Combine individual genes and clusters:
all_genes <- c(all_genes, score_vars)

# List stressors (categories) different than ECONOMIC-HADSHIP:
stressors_cat <- c( "economic_hardship_ch_score", "emotional_psychological_abuse_ch_score",  "loneliness_ad_score" , "neglect_ch_score", "physical_abuse_ch_score", "social_isolation_ad_score")

subset_white_final_GE_dic_trans$RA6RPLATE = as.factor(subset_white_final_GE_dic_trans$RA6RPLATE)
```


###*CF-Linear:

#### A) Executive Function (C3TCTFLU) - linear:


```{r}
library(mediation)
library(lmtest)
library(VGAM)
library(mgcv)

# Initialize lists to store mediation and moderation results:
mediation_results_s <- list()

# Loop through each gene:
for (gene in all_genes) {
  # Loop through each stress variable
  for (stress in stressors_cat) {
    
    # Track running:
    cat("Running: ", stress, " and ", gene, "\n")
    
  ##### 1) Define the models:
    
    ## A) Mediator model: Stress vs GE:
      # Determine number of unique values for each stressor
      unique_vals <- length(unique(subset_white_final_GE_dic_trans[[stress]]))
      
      # Decide the maximum k (knots or basis functions) to avoid overfitting:
      k_value <- min(unique_vals - 1, 8)  # e.g k=6 when stressors have 7 unique values (0-6)
      
      # Define the GAM model with a dynamic "k": 
      model_M <- lm(as.formula(paste(gene, "~", stress, "+ C1PRSEX + C1PRAGE + SES + C1SBMI   + C1SA26F + C1SA11T + RA6RCD3E + RA6RCD3D + RA6RCD8A + RA6RCD14 + RA6RCD19 + RA6RFCGR3A + RA6RNCAM1 + RA6RCD4")), data = subset_white_final_GE_dic_trans)
    
    ## B) Outcome model: Stress vs CF + GE:
      model_Y <- glm(as.formula(paste("C3TCTFLU ~", stress, "+", gene, "+ C1PRSEX + C1PRAGE + SES + C1SBMI   + C1SA26F + C1SA11T")),
                   family = gaussian(link = "identity"), # Quantitative outcome
                   data = subset_white_final_GE_dic_trans)
    

    #### 2) Calculate min and max of gene variable
    min_stress_value <- min(subset_white_final_GE_dic_trans[[stress]])
    max_stress_value <- max(subset_white_final_GE_dic_trans[[stress]])

    
    ### 3) Run the mediation analysis 
    set.seed(1234)
    mediations_s <- mediate(model_M, model_Y,
                            treat = stress, # Use stressors as quantitative variables
                            mediator = gene,
                            robustSE = TRUE, # This activates robust standard errors
                            sims = 1000,
                            treat.value = max_stress_value, # MAX stress value
                            control.value = min_stress_value) # Minimum stress value
    
    # Store results
    mediation_results_s[[paste(stress, gene, sep = "_")]] <- mediations_s

  }
}

# Print all mediation results
for (result in names(mediation_results_s)) {
  stress_and_gene <- unlist(strsplit(result, "_"))
  stress <- stress_and_gene[1]
  gene <- stress_and_gene[2]
  cat("1) Executive Function (C3TCTFLU): Mediation result of the stressor:", stress, ", and the gene", gene, ":\n")
  print(summary(mediation_results_s[[result]]))
  
}


```



```{r}
##################### Create the output table to storage the mediation and moderation results:

### Function for marking p-values based on significance:
# @param pval - the pvalue
# @return - returns a significance marker similar to how R marks significance
mark_pvals <- function(pval){
  if (pval < 0.001){
    return("***")
  } else if (pval < 0.01){
    return("**")
  } else if (pval < 0.05){
    return("*")
  } else if(pval < 0.1){
    return(".")
  } else return(" ")
}


### Function to correctly split a "stress_gene" key into its two components.
# @param key - the combined key, e.g. "economic_hardship_ch_score_RA6RFOS"
# @param stressors_cat - character vector of all valid stressor category names
# @return - a list with $stress and $gene
parse_key <- function(key, stressors_cat){
  # Find which known stressor name is an exact prefix of this key (followed by "_")
  matched <- stressors_cat[sapply(stressors_cat, function(s) startsWith(key, paste0(s, "_")))]
  
  if (length(matched) == 0){
    stop("No matching stressor found for key: ", key,
         " -- check that stressors_cat matches the names used when building mediation_results_s.")
  }
  if (length(matched) > 1){
    # If more than one stressor name is a valid prefix, take the longest match
    # (avoids partial-prefix collisions between stressor names)
    matched <- matched[which.max(nchar(matched))]
  }
  
  stress <- matched[1]
  gene <- sub(paste0("^", stress, "_"), "", key)
  
  return(list(stress = stress, gene = gene))
}


### Function for making table of summary mediation results (into csv):
# @param - med.list: the list containing all the summary stats for the MEDIATION
# @param - CF: the cognitive function variable
# @param - sum.df: the pre-existing data frame I want to add the summary to
# @param - stressors_cat: character vector of all valid stressor category names (needed for correct key parsing)
tabulate_results <- function(med.list, CF, sum.df = NULL, stressors_cat){
  # Create a list with column names for the table:
  c.n <- c("Stressor",  "Gene", "CF",   
           # 1) Mediations: Indirect effect-ACME results:
           "MED: Ind_effect_ACME (Estimate)",   "MED: Ind_effect_ACME (CI Lower)",  "MED: Ind_effect_ACME (CI Upper)",  "MED: Ind_effect_ACME (p-value)",   "MED: Ind_effect_ACME (pvalue-marking)", "MED: Proportion_mediated_ACME (avg)",
           # 2) Mediations: Direct effect-ADE results:
           "MED: Dir_effect_ADE (Estimate)",    "MED: Dir_effect_ADE (CI Lower)",   "MED: Dir_effect_ADE (CI Upper)",   
           "MED: Dir_effect_ADE (p-value)", "MED: Dir_effect_ADE (pvalue-marking)")
  
  # Initialize a new dataframe:
  if (is.null(sum.df)){
    sum.df <- data.frame(matrix(ncol = 14, nrow = 0))
    colnames(sum.df) <- c.n # Assign column names
  }
  
  # Iterate through all mediation results stored in med.list:
  for (l in names(med.list)){
    # FIX: use parse_key() instead of naive strsplit(l, "_"), which broke on multi-word stressor names like "economic_hardship_ch_score".
    parsed <- parse_key(l, stressors_cat)
    stressor <- parsed$stress
    gene <- parsed$gene
    
    lSum.df <- summary(med.list[[l]]) # Extract summary results from MEDIATION analysis
    
    # Populate the table row by row:
    new.r <- c(
      stressor, gene, CF, 
      # 1) Mediations: Indirect effect-ACME results:
      lSum.df$d.avg, lSum.df$d.avg.ci[1], lSum.df$d.avg.ci[2], 
      formatC(lSum.df$d.avg.p, format = "f", digits = 7), # p-value with 5 decimal points
      mark_pvals(lSum.df$d.avg.p), lSum.df$n.avg,
      # 2) Mediations: Direct effect-ADE results:
      lSum.df$z.avg, lSum.df$z.avg.ci[1], lSum.df$z.avg.ci[2], 
      formatC(lSum.df$z.avg.p, format = "f", digits = 7), 
      mark_pvals(lSum.df$z.avg.p))
    
    # Append each row to the summary dataframe:
    nr <- nrow(sum.df)
    sum.df[nr+1,] <- new.r # Add each row below the last existent
  } 
  return(sum.df)
}

GE.df <- tabulate_results(mediation_results_s, "Executive Function (C3TCTFLU)", stressors_cat = stressors_cat)

```

###*CF-Poisson:

#### E) Immediate Episodic Memory (C3TWLITU) - poisson:


```{r}

library(mediation)
library(lmtest)
library(VGAM)  

# Initialize lists to store mediation and moderation results:
mediation_results_s <- list()

# Loop through each gene:
for (gene in all_genes) {
  # Loop through each stress variable

  ##### 1) Define the models:
```

```{r}
      model_M <- lm(as.formula(paste(gene, "~", stress, "+ C1PRSEX + C1PRAGE + SES + C1SBMI   + C1SA26F + C1SA11T + RA6RCD3E + RA6RCD3D + RA6RCD8A + RA6RCD14 + RA6RCD19 + RA6RFCGR3A + RA6RNCAM1 + RA6RCD4")), data = subset_white_final_GE_dic_trans)
    
    ## B) Outcome model: Stress vs CF + GE:
      model_Y <- glm(as.formula(paste("C3TNSTOT ~", stress, "+", gene, "+ C1PRSEX + C1PRAGE + SES + C1SBMI   + C1SA26F + C1SA11T")),
                   family = poisson(link = "log"), # Count outcome -> Poisson regression
                   data = subset_white_final_GE_dic_trans)
    

    #### 2) Calculate min and max of gene variable
    min_stress_value <- min(subset_white_final_GE_dic_trans[[stress]])
    max_stress_value <- max(subset_white_final_GE_dic_trans[[stress]])
    
    ### 3) Run the mediation analysis 
    set.seed(1234)
    mediations_s <- mediate(model_M, model_Y,
                            treat = stress, # Use stressors as quantitative variables
                            mediator = gene,
                            robustSE = TRUE, # This activates robust standard errors
                             sims = 1000,
                            treat.value = max_stress_value, # MAX stress value
                            control.value = min_stress_value) # Minimum stress value
    
    # Store results
    mediation_results_s[[paste(stress, gene, sep = "_")]] <- mediations_s

  }
}

# Print all mediation results
for (result in names(mediation_results_s)) {
  stress_and_gene <- unlist(strsplit(result, "_"))
  stress <- stress_and_gene[1]
  gene <- stress_and_gene[2]
  cat("1) Inductive Reasoning (C3TNSTOT): Mediation result of the stressor:", stress, ", and the gene", gene, ":\n")
  print(summary(mediation_results_s[[result]]))
  
}


#### Apply the function to populate the already created output table:
GE_2.df <- tabulate_results(mediation_results_s, "Inductive Reasoning (C3TNSTOT)", GE_2.df , stressors_cat = stressors_cat)
```
